dedupe_keys.name: ilmasto opas climate change impact maps of finland 10 km grid energy demand water resources agriculture ecosystems

description: The Ilmasto-opas impact map tool shows modelled impacts of climate change across Finland on a regular 10 by 10 km grid. The tool read on 2026-09-28, described as a pilot, offers themes for agriculture, energy demand, water resources, bird species distributions and terrestrial ecosystems, including the heating and cooling energy demand of buildings and water resource variables as well as temperature and precipitation change, for a reference period and 2011-2040, 2041-2070 and 2071-2100, under the SRES scenarios A1B, A2 and B1 with the CSIRO-Mk3.5, IPSL-CM4 and MIROC3.2 climate models; statistics can be shown for all Finland or one region, and a data download and metadata link is provided; extensions were funded by the EU Horizon 2020 programme. Coverage is national. Access is free; no licence is stated in the tool. Caveats: the SRES scenarios and older climate models are superseded by CMIP6 projections, and the tool is labelled a pilot. It supports climate adaptation and capacity planning studies of building energy demand and water supply in Finland. Related record: data-hip-denmark-hydrological-information-and-prediction offers comparable climate-driven hydrology for Denmark.
